overview.description: The PGIM Jennison International Core Equity ETF (PJIN) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund invests in non-US companies of any market-cap through an actively managed portfolio. Securities are selected through proprietary fundamental research combined with a quantitative process. PJIN was launched on Sep 1, 2026 and is issued by PGIM.
